title: Five Structures and Other Works Built into the Bound Archons
description: Two paired enumerations of the constructive works built through the very bodies of the bound archons. The Five: disc on Omophoros (bearing), Pillar of Glory (ascent), molding of the Gehennas (binding), pillars in the great sea (foundation), four walls around strongholds (boundary). The Other Works: the Great Builder's tenfold sequence of building anew — heavens, ships filling the heights, wheels sending forth life, gates opened toward Error, separation of night and day, the abortions falling, metensomatosis instituted in the Zone.
